name: smwsprites-thunder-lakitu
title: Thunder Lakitu
description:
A Lakitu which follows Mario around the screen and drops lightning bolts. After dropping 3, it'll move down to the ground so that Mario can hit it. It dies by disappearing in a puff of smoke after 6 hits.

Do not use in levels with more than 1 screen. Make sure to set the extra bit when placing it.

See the readme for instructions on how to insert it. Check out both ASM files for customization options.
